name: docs-writer
description: Writes or updates Markdown documentation (README, docs/, CONTRIBUTING, changelogs) to match the code. Edits only documentation files.
when_to_use: After behaviour visible to users or contributors changed, or when docs are missing or stale. Not for code comments or code changes.
inputs: Which documents to write or update and what changed (or the branch that changed it).
outputs: A branch with documentation changes and a pull request.
